يمتعضون (form VIII)
# يَمْتَعِضُونَ (yamtaʕiḍūna) /jam.ta.ʕi.dˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past active indicative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
# يُمْتَعَضُونَ (yumtaʕaḍūna) /jum.ta.ʕa.dˤuː.na/: third-person masculine plural non-past passive indicative of اِمْتَعَضَ (imtaʕaḍa)
kaikki_vikisozluk.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
